title: WORKING TOGETHER IS A SUCCESS
content:
KADCOS Lubaga cooperative Society wishes the community to blossom financially as it strives to offer financial and non-financial services to members in Kampala Archdiocese in an efficient, affordable and sustainable manner. Through our core values of integrity, efficiency, reliability, transparency, equality, confidentiality and accountability, the society is committed to ensuring prosperity of all its members through registering a multitude of financial successes from them.

Our existence for over 10 years has enabled us build strong relationships with our members enabling us to work closely with them to understand their unique needs and deliver tailored top notch quality services and products. We continue to take pride in the financial development of our members and we look forward to more people joining us to transform their business ideas and goal into reality. We encourage you to explore our services and products and engage us to experience a reason why it’s the best choice in cooperating with KADCOS Lubaga Cooperative society.

In keeping the affection and trust shown by members, the management of KADCOS gives special attention to the priority of member satisfaction and quality services as we look forward in the unification of all cooperative societies in Kampala Archdiocese spearheaded by Caritas Kampala Cooperative office. “Unleashing opportunities for financial, social inclusion and community livelihood” in Kampala Archdiocese is the epitome of our existence.

Coming together is a beginning, Keeping together is progress, and Working together is Success.
